lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in at least six distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs exhibit higher vertical density than horizontal, forming an approximate grid where vertical inter-blob spacing is roughly 1.5 times the blob diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary lateral blobs. These bands are most prominent on the posterior half of the visible flank, where each high-luminance blob serves as a nodal point centered within the vertical stripe.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin is visible in the lower-central frame, featuring a high density of smaller, less-defined high-luminance blobs. Two Echeneidae (remora) individuals are visible attached to the ventral-lateral region near the base of the pectoral fin.
